description: Four sites in jobs/transport.rs build a tuple shape (layout_from_demand, TransportRecipe::Tuple/tuple_layout, joined_tuple_structural, combine_capture_requirements). All ask one function; the bound turns on here. Removes tuple_refined_demand and the repeated has_exact_tuple_arity / exact_tuple_field_tys reads. Signal: widest signature at 1,000 elements is a handful of parameters; wide5000 run time; pins may only fall.
title: One function decides how a tuple travels
